title: House and Choir
author: O. M. Galloway
blurb: Beatrix Eriksen, a twin who came home to bury the wrong sibling, doesn't believe, has never believed, will not begin believing now. Then the excavation crew unearths a door, sealed from the inside — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must learn the song's last verse without singing along, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
